checks.name: Live membership renderer displays all three prices and days from the expected payment-center catalog.
Actual signed-out dialog shows online Alipay and WeChat, keeps checkout disabled, and has no manual QR or report entry.
signed-out dialog desktop: no horizontal overflow
unsigned payment return 375px: no horizontal overflow
Forged payment return parameters are consumed without authentication, status lookup, checkout or entitlement.
Signed-out purchase guidance returns focus to the real account login form without submitting it.
Network allowlist admitted only public read-only account actions and static GETs; no cookies or mutations.

screenshots.observation: Desktop membership hero is readable with aligned navigation and no horizontal overflow.
Desktop displays live daily 3.00, monthly 19.90, yearly 69.90 CNY prices and online-only opening instructions.
375px pricing layout stacks cards vertically without horizontal overflow; additional cards remain below the viewport.
375px membership hero and account/menu controls remain readable without horizontal overflow.
Desktop signed-out purchase dialog shows both online providers, disabled checkout, login guidance, existing-code redemption, and no manual collection QR/report.
375px signed-out purchase dialog fits the viewport with visible login guidance and disabled online purchase controls.
Forged return keeps the 375px dialog signed out; checkout and order status controls remain disabled.
Login guidance opens the real account form without entering email, submitting login, or sending a code.

limitations: Anonymous public-page rendering and read-only account actions only.
Authenticated provider switching, live checkout, Native scanning, payment settlement, and entitlement grants were not performed.
No user-installed desktop or mobile client was modified, reset, installed, or relaunched.
sanitization: Contains only public catalog data, action counts, assertions, screenshot basenames and hashes; no cookies, tokens, credentials, emails, business orders, request bodies or private absolute paths.
